en: In this course, we'll build a Twitter, an X
clone, a basic one at least, where users can
authenticate, log in,
and then share posts, view the posts of
others, and you can also follow other users
and have a feed of the posts shared by those
users. Now,
this course is not about this app primarily
though. We're going to build it with
TypeScript and Bun, but you don't need to
know these technologies. It's just a demo
there to showcase some of Pie's
capabilities. And of course, therefore, I'll
also provide finished code snapshots. But
again, it's not mostly about the code, but
instead about using Pie efficiently. And
therefore, in this section here, I'll now
share some steps to go through to
make Pie even more useful than it is out of
the box when it comes to building
applications like this. Some tips and tricks
I gathered over the last months and I find
important to share so that you can work with
Pie efficiently.
